description: Build @minamorl/magnetite tarball from clean tree and smoke-test package install, exports, and core/transport behavior in an isolated directory
smoke: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { existsSync } from "node:fs"; import * as root from "@minamorl/magnetite"; import * as core from "@minamorl/magnetite/core"; for (const k of ["Client", "connect", "Server", "ServerConnection", "Core", "issueIdentifier", "systemClock"]) assert.ok(k in root, "missing root export: " + k); for (const k of ["Core", "issueIdentifier"]) assert.ok(k in core, "missing core export: " + k); assert.equal(root.Core, core.Core); assert.equal(root.issueIdentifier, core.issueIdentifier); assert.equal(existsSync("node_modules/@minamorl/magnetite/.cc-inspect.json"), false); assert.equal(existsSync("node_modules/@minamorl/magnetite/dist/index.d.ts"), true); assert.equal(existsSync("node_modules/@minamorl/magnetite/dist/core.d.ts"), true); const id = core.issueIdentifier(1, (n) => new Uint8Array(n).fill(255)); assert.equal(id, "00000000-0001-7fff-bfff-ffffffffffff"); assert.equal(typeof root.systemClock.now(), "number"); const c = new core.Core({ role: "client", identifier: id, now: 0 }); assert.ok(c.dispatch({ type: "ready", socket: "s1" }).effects.some((e) => e.type === "connected")); assert.equal(c.state, "open"); const sent = c.dispatch({ type: "send", data: { ok: true } }); assert.equal(sent.result, "accepted"); assert.equal(sent.seq, 1); const recv = c.dispatch({ type: "data", socket: "s1", seq: 1, data: "pong" }); assert.ok(recv.effects.some((e) => e.type === "deliver" && e.seq === 1 && e.data === "pong")); c.dispatch({ type: "ack", socket: "s1", seq: 1 }); assert.equal(c.record.acknowledged, 1); assert.equal(c.record.pending.length, 0); assert.equal(c.dispatch({ type: "close" }).result, "ok"); assert.equal(c.state, "closed"); let t = 0, jobId = 0; const jobs = new Map(); const clock = { now: () => t, setTimeout: (fn, ms) => { const k = ++jobId; jobs.set(k, { at: t + ms, fn }); return k; }, clearTimeout: (k) => { jobs.delete(k); } }; const advance = (ms) => { const end = t + ms; for (let i = 0; i < 10000; i++) { const next = [...jobs].sort((a, b) => a[1].at - b[1].at || a[0] - b[0])[0]; if (!next || next[1].at > end) break; jobs.delete(next[0]); t = next[1].at; next[1].fn(); } t = end; }; const mkSock = () => { const h = new Map(); const s = { readyState: 0, peer: null, addEventListener(type, fn) { (h.get(type) ?? h.set(type, []).get(type)).push(fn); }, emit(type, ev = {}) { for (const fn of h.get(type) ?? []) fn(ev); }, send(data) { if (s.readyState !== 1) throw new Error("not open"); clock.setTimeout(() => { if (s.peer.readyState === 1) s.peer.emit("message", { data }); }, 0); }, close() { if (s.readyState >= 2) return; s.readyState = 2; clock.setTimeout(() => { s.readyState = 3; s.emit("close"); if (s.peer.readyState < 2) { s.peer.readyState = 3; s.peer.emit("close"); } }, 0); } }; return s; }; const srvRecv = [], cliRecv = [], conns = [], ends = [], pairs = []; const timing = { clock, tickInterval: 5, pingAfter: 40, lossAfter: 80, expiryAfter: 500 }; const server = new root.Server({ ...timing, randomBytes: (n) => new Uint8Array(n).fill(7), onConnection: (conn) => { assert.ok(conn instanceof root.ServerConnection); conns.push(conn); conn.setCallbacks({ onReceive: (d) => srvRecv.push(d) }); } }); const client = root.connect("ws://smoke.invalid", { ...timing, retryInitial: 10, retryMax: 20, random: () => 0, socketFactory: () => { const a = mkSock(), b = mkSock(); a.peer = b; b.peer = a; pairs.push([a, b]); server.accept(b); clock.setTimeout(() => { a.readyState = b.readyState = 1; a.emit("open"); }, 0); return a; }, onReceive: (d) => cliRecv.push(d), onEnd: (n) => ends.push(n) }); assert.ok(client instanceof root.Client); advance(0); assert.equal(client.state, "open"); assert.equal(conns.length, 1); assert.equal(client.send("hi").result, "accepted"); assert.equal(conns[0].send("yo").result, "accepted"); advance(1); assert.deepEqual(srvRecv, ["hi"]); assert.deepEqual(cliRecv, ["yo"]); pairs[0][0].close(); advance(0); assert.equal(client.state, "disconnected"); assert.equal(client.send("held").result, "accepted"); advance(20); assert.equal(client.state, "open"); assert.deepEqual(srvRecv, ["hi", "held"]); client.close(); advance(0); assert.equal(client.state, "closed"); assert.equal(ends[0].reason, "closed_by_caller"); console.log("magnetite smoke ok");'
